tools.name: generate_llms_txt
tools.description: Automatically crawl any public website URL and generate a standard, token-efficient index-level /llms.txt file for AI agent context. 100% free with core page categorization, descriptions, and clean markdown.

tools.name: generate_llms_full_txt
tools.description: Deep-crawl up to 50 pages of a website to generate a comprehensive /llms-full.txt content index with full body markdown for AI agents. Generates full bundle immediately when session authorization is provided.

tools.name: validate_llms_txt
tools.description: Validate any public llms.txt or llms-full.txt file URL for standard compliance, missing H1, broken links, structure errors, and token count.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "generate_llms_full_txt" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
